workload.schedule: Each client starts requests no more frequently than once per second, choosing by a deterministic round-robin through the weighted operation cycle, offset by client number. Slow requests delay that client's next start; any in-flight request may finish after the request-start scheduling window.
limitations: The mix and rate are explicit synthetic choices, not derived from tenant request telemetry.

Calls exercise the production compiled query service and Prisma read store directly with a dedicated NOINHERIT login and explicit SELECT grants, not HTTP routing, authentication, browser behavior, or network latency.
The Session 12 corpus has two fiscal years and a small synthetic record set; it is not a representative production-size database.
No source-change-to-verified-buyer-visible update latency, model cost, buyer workflow outcome, or production/AWS latency is measured.
